learningObjectives: Calculate and interpret common descriptive statistics.
Understand variance, standard deviation, and distribution spread.
Use statistical measures to summarize datasets.

activities.title: Explore Central Tendency
activities.instruction: Adjust the dataset and observe mean, median, and mode.

content.concept: Mean, median, and mode describe the central tendency of a dataset from different perspectives.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Anatomy of Standard Deviation
activities.instruction: Explore each component of the calculation.

content.concept: Standard deviation measures how widely values are distributed around the mean.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Match Statistics to Meaning
activities.instruction: Match each statistic with its interpretation.

content.concept: Range, variance, standard deviation, percentiles, and quartiles describe different aspects of data distribution.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Build a Statistical Summary
activities.instruction: Select the measures needed to summarize the dataset.

content.concept: A statistical summary provides compact information about the center, spread, and distribution of numerical data.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
